coverage.instructions: Judging only the supplied requirement text and the supplied resolved test source: how completely does the mapped test verify the requirement's stated behaviors?

criteria.full: Every material stated behavior has a direct outcome assertion
criteria.partial: At least one material behavior is asserted and at least one is not
criteria.none: The mapping does not meaningfully verify the requirement
criteria.ambiguous: The requirement's meaning prevents a coverage decision

mocked_only.instructions: Judging only the supplied resolved test source: does the test verify only mocked or stubbed behavior rather than real outcomes?

criteria.true: Assertions target mocks/stubs or the test never exercises real behavior
criteria.false: The test asserts real outcomes of real exercised behavior

execution_only.instructions: Judging only the supplied resolved test source: is the test assertion-free or does it merely execute code without asserting outcomes?

criteria.true: No outcome assertions; the test only runs code (line coverage is not behavioral coverage)
